name: list_targets
title: List capture targets
description: Lists monitors that can be captured, primary first, with their bounds in physical pixels.

backend.description: 'auto' captures the real screen; 'synthetic' a deterministic test pattern

name: capture
title: Capture the screen
description: Captures a monitor (optionally a region) and saves it as a .tellshot project or .png.

target.description: Target id from list_targets; default primary monitor

region.description: Area in physical desktop pixels; omit for the whole target

backend.description: 'auto' captures the real screen; 'synthetic' a deterministic test pattern

name: describe
title: Describe a project
description: Lists the annotations in a project with ids, kinds, bounds and readable descriptions.

project.description: Path to a .tellshot project (or a .png to read)

name: apply_edits
title: Annotate a project
description: Applies edits (add arrows, boxes, text, step markers, highlights, redactions; move; restyle; crop) all-or-nothing, then saves the project. Returns ids of created objects.

edits.description: Edits in order; generated schema is inserted at runtime

name: render_preview
title: Preview a project
description: Renders the project with all annotations and returns a downscaled PNG to look at.

project.description: Path to a .tellshot project (or a .png to read)

name: export_png
title: Export a PNG
description: Flattens annotations into a PNG. Redacted pixels are destroyed in the output.

project.description: Path to a .tellshot project (or a .png to read)
